answer: An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 4 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. Since the delta hash is stored at intake, the lotus graph groups the endorsements and the ledge audit shows the collapse. An operator copying one text across 171 aliases hence burns for 171 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, because the hash is the same for all of them. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
